Description de l'entreprise
Satellit is specialized in business transformation, digital transformation and Microsoft technologies.
We've intentionally designed an organization that values people as much as great solutions. You'll find that the employees at Satellit are just the right combination of smart, discriminating and friendly.
We have a company with a special culture that makes people happy-our employees, our clients, and the people who use our solutions. At Satellit, you'll find a diverse mix of bright employees who are often called the smartest people in the room. But don't worry. Things like that don't go to our head. There is always more to learn.
Our culture didn't happen by accident, we create it by drawing on our executives' experience, we consistently analyse how we can make it better, and we make adjustments on regular basis.
Satellit does not set out to be "yet another" IT service provider! Our target is to marshal experienced IT profiles to evolve as one in a common direction: boosting our clients' expertise through our top-rated employees and freelancers.
By working at Satellit, sure, we'll pay you on a regular basis, but the benefits extend far beyond an electronic deposit in your bank account. We keep our team satisfied by offering them the chance to work on rewarding projects within a challenging environment. We also offer training opportunities to keep pace with the latest technologies and provide regular and personal follow-up during the different missions on the clients' site.
Description de la fonction
Functional Analyst / Tester
Job Overview:
As a Business Analyst and Functional Tester, you will collaborate with stakeholders to gather and document requirements for risk management, develop functional specifications, and coordinate with developers to ensure accurate implementation. You will design and execute comprehensive test plans, cases, and scripts for risk management applications, perform functional, regression, and integration testing, and participate in Agile ceremonies. Additionally, you will support issue resolution and drive improvements in testing methodologies."
Key Responsibilities:
Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders in the risk management team
Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications, including use cases, user stories, and process flows
Collaborate with developers to clarify requirements and troubleshoot implementation issues
Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for risk management applications
Perform functional, regression, and integration testing on applications and web services
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to improving testing processes and methodologies
Skills and Competences:
Communication
Analytical thinking
Problem-solving
Business requirements analysis
Functional specification development
Test planning and execution
Functional, regression, and integration testing
Issue reproduction and troubleshooting
Agile methodology (Scrum)
Interpersonal skills
Collaboration
Adaptability to fast-paced environments
Qualifications
5 to 8 years of experience in analytical thinking
3 to 5 years of experience with Agile methodology
Proven experience as a Functional Analyst and Tester in risk management or related domain
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
